title: Farah Citadel

terrainReference.basis: Approximate ground just outside the mapped southeast entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap city wall with 68 tagged bastion nodes and the tagged southeast entrance.
mapIdentity.scope: 69 mapped wall nodes, 68 tagged bastions, the tagged southeast entrance and two cleared September 2004 views of the portico.

note: Mapped wall positions and the original elevation field control the plan. The weathered sections, surviving heights and portico placement are reasonable estimates.
